comparison.objective: Feeds a cable through a gland, tightens its cap nut, and verifies pull retention; the candidate calibrates and locks an angular stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2145 combines deformable-cable insertion with threaded cap tightening and seal compression; the candidate uses two rigid tools to counterhold a screw during jam-nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2145 checks sheath depth, a bounded nut-turn window, 30 N pull retention, and crushing; the candidate checks angular accuracy, drift, nut retention, cycling, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both tighten threaded hardware and perform a retention test, but cable sealing/pull anchorage does not measure coupled setpoint preservation under locknut torque.

review_notes: Cable gland threaded nut plus seal and pull retention test. Compare actual threads/tightening/functional-retention skills; do not classify distinct merely by different hardware.
